info.name: SpeakHalo API - Complete Test Suite
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for all SpeakHalo API endpoints (180+ requests across 27 folders). Includes positive tests, negative tests (401/403/404/400), pagination, search, and variable chaining.

Setup:
1. Import this collection and the SpeakHalo.postman_environment.json
2. Set userEmail/userPassword and adminEmail/adminPassword in the environment
3. Run the Auth folder first to get tokens
4. Run other folders in order - they chain IDs automatically

Base URL: http://localhost:5000/api/v1
